name: Turn to Dust (Thaumaturgy (Hands of Destruction), Advanced)

system.description: After gaining a firm grip with a Physical Challenge, each Physical Trait you spend ages the victim ten years, killing mortals aged past fifty years instantly and inflicting the Negative Trait Repugnant on vampires similarly aged.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Instant, cumulative effect permanent on mortals
